levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد
محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «جميعا» converges the Saffar route and the Sa'd route at أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى (rule 3): one group each, the tail written once.
«عن أخيه الحسين» and «عن أبيه علي بن يقطين» are single links under the name alone (rule 7).
The scene (Rashid, the man who makes a show, Abu al-Hasan and the lion-figure) is not written as links. Whether Ali b. Yaqtin saw it or heard it is not settled, so this is a ruling (rule 11).
